integrity: Analytical arguments in RESULT.md prove all quantifiers. The standard-library numerical verifier is a finite supplementary check, not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: No conclusion for coupled parameter/gradient dynamics, correlated innovations, positive denominator floors, or non-Gaussian small-ball laws.
Sharp stationary asymptotics are proved for beta tending to zero, not for beta tending to one.
Historical priority remains uncertain against older generic results on geometric Gaussian quadratic forms.
scientific_scope: Exact scalar bias-corrected and stationary RMSprop second-moment recursion for independent real standard Gaussian innovations, with no positive denominator floor.
title: A half-integer inverse-moment staircase for a Gaussian RMSprop variance accumulator
